summary: This bill requires the President to direct federal agencies to declassify and publicly release all documents and reports related to unidentified anomalous phenomena within 270 days of enactment, and to provide quarterly progress reports to Congress.

scores.thoughts: This bill would require federal departments and agencies to declassify and make public documents related to unidentified anomalous phenomena, and the President to report on this progress. While these activities would incur some administrative costs, the bill does not appropriate new funds or establish new programs, so the impact on overall government spending is minimal and indirect.
